title: Brokoli pipeline IR 2.3
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for the pipeline intermediate representation the server accepts at create/update/import (ADR-014 rule 1; issue #109 M1). Extends IR 2.2 per ADR-050 phase 2 with a 'group' node: a named subgraph (its own 'nodes' and 'edges', one input port and one output port) that, with a 'map' block in its config, runs once per item of the collection on its single incoming edge, its per-item outputs combined by 'collect'. Additive over 2.0-2.2: a document carrying none of the group fields is a valid 2.3 document, and a 2.3 document keeps 2.1 conditional-edge and 2.2 task-interface semantics (the server gates those by ordered version comparison, models.IRVersionAtLeast, not string equality). Accepting this IR version does not imply the server runs groups: emitting a group additionally requires the 'mapped-groups' execution feature (models.SupportedExecutionFeatures). 'collect' lists only the modes this revision runs ('union', 'none'); 'list' arrives with nested mapping. Transcribed alongside models.Pipeline/models.Node exactly as pipeline-ir-2.2.json is; a change to either without the other is a contract break, enforced by models/ir_schema_contract_test.go.

id.description: Server-assigned identity. Ignored on create (regenerated); immutable on update.

ir_version.description: Empty means a pre-versioned legacy client; accepted with 2.0 semantics. A 'group' node requires 2.3.

catchup.description: Opt into per-interval catch-up (ADR-028 phase 2): after downtime, one run per missed schedule interval, oldest first, instead of the default single catch-up run for the most recently missed tick.

draft.description: Work in progress. A draft skips executable validation when it is persisted, and in exchange cannot run by any route: not the scheduler, a manual or async run, a webhook, a backfill, or dependency fan-out. Publishing clears the flag and validates in full. Present so an export and re-import of an unfinished pipeline round-trips; deploying tools have no reason to set it.

params.description: The legacy untyped run-parameter map (ADR-032 section 3: 'the legacy top-level params: map[string]string remains readable during migration'). Distinct from 'parameters' below -- never silently merged with it.

parameters.description: Typed pipeline parameter declarations (ADR-032 section 3). Additive and optional; a server that does not yet interpret this field still accepts and echoes it verbatim like any other forward-compatible field. Not yet validated against run requests -- that is ADR-032 rollout step 4.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks keyed by event name.

sla_deadline.description: HH:MM daily completion deadline. Stored by every edition; monitored only by enterprise deployments.

extensions.description: The one open namespace in an otherwise fail-closed payload (ADR-014 rules 8/9): newer clients park fields this server doesn't understand here; the server persists and echoes them verbatim without interpreting them.

pipeline_id.description: Stable logical slug -- deploy tooling and git-sync match on this.

type.description: Node type string. Deliberately NOT an enum: executors (plugins) may claim types beyond the built-in set. Whether a type is executable on a given server is decided by executable validation at save time, not by this schema.

config.description: Free-form node configuration, interpreted per type. Unknown keys inside config are tolerated (and today, silently ignored) -- narrowing this is #109 M2 territory. A group node's 'map' block (over/key/max_items/max_parallel/on_item_failure) lives here, exactly as every other mappable node's does.

interface.description: The node's ADR-032 task interface (named ports, cardinality, and any task-local parameters), when known. Additive and optional; absent means unknown, never a guess (ADR-032 section 6). Not yet populated by any server code path in this schema revision -- see docs/schema/task-interface-canonicalization.md and issue #439 step 2 for the reference table of which built-in node types have an already-known interface and why several are deliberately excluded.

nodes.description: A group node's inner subgraph (ADR-050 phase 2). Empty/absent for every other node type. Each inner node is itself a node; the group runs this subgraph once per mapped item.

edges.description: The edges of a group node's inner subgraph. Empty/absent for every other node type.

collect.description: How a mapped group's per-item outputs become its single output: 'union' concatenates them into one dataset, 'none' discards them (a group run for its sinks' side effects). 'list' (a re-mappable collection) arrives with nested mapping. Empty/absent for a non-group node.

condition.description: Branch label for edges leaving a condition node. Requires ir_version 2.1 or later; every edge leaving a condition node must carry one. Omitted entirely (never null) on ordinary edges.
